subject.title: bootstrap-extra-files: opt-in support for operator-curated files with custom names

question: Should custom bootstrap basenames use a global allowCustomNames opt-in, remain limited to exact session-scoped entries, or continue to be rejected?
rationale: Current main deliberately enforces the basename allowlist, while two open implementation approaches propose materially different permanent hook contracts; repository evidence cannot determine the intended product policy.

options.title: Global explicit opt-in
options.body: Permit custom basenames only for explicitly listed paths when allowCustomNames is enabled, retaining the current default and all containment and size guards.

options.title: Session-scoped only
options.body: Use the older candidate's exact sessions[sessionKey] design so custom files cannot be injected globally into every session.

options.title: Keep the allowlist
options.body: Retain recognized bootstrap names and decline expansion of privileged bootstrap context.

recommendation.title: Global explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Permit custom basenames only for explicitly listed paths when allowCustomNames is enabled, retaining the current default and all containment and size guards.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the bundled hook and its allowlist and loader contract, making them the strongest feature-history routing candidate.
